verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas exposes a scriptable Editor API explicitly for 'asset management' automation and custom tool integration, a REST API, and a dedicated CLI/library (SplatTransform) for batch converting, filtering, merging and LOD-generating splat assets — all enabling non-interactive asset processing. However there's no documented first-class 'import hook' or configurable import-preset system (e.g., auto-triggered on-upload transforms for textures/models) comparable to engines with dedicated asset pipeline plugins, and community notes friction with asset uploading in the browser-based editor. Missing for 10: documented import-hook/trigger system, named import presets for standard asset types, independent confirmation of automated pipeline scripts in production use.
